setting-enabled-desc: Master switch for ElkUtils commands and hotkeys. When OFF, all /elk subcommands and the recall/goto hotkeys are no-ops.
setting-max_search_radius-desc: How far out (horizontally) ElkUtils looks for your closest owned elk. Only loaded chunks are scanned; an elk in an unloaded chunk can't be found regardless of this value.
setting-allow_cross_player-desc: When ON, admins may use /elk send <player> and /elk fetch <player>. When OFF, those subcommands require root privilege.
hotkey-goto: ElkUtils: teleport me to my elk
cmd-desc: Admin teleport utilities for tamed elk. Subcommands: recall, goto, send, fetch, move.
cmd-recall-desc: Teleport your closest owned elk to your position.
cmd-goto-desc: Teleport yourself to your closest owned elk.
cmd-send-desc: Teleport your closest owned elk to another player. Usage: /elk send <player>
cmd-fetch-desc: Teleport another player to your closest owned elk. Usage: /elk fetch <player>
cmd-move-desc: Teleport your closest owned elk to absolute coordinates. Usage: /elk move <x> <y> <z>
msg-disabled: ElkUtils is disabled in the mod config.
msg-cross-disabled: Cross-player teleports are disabled in the mod config.
msg-no-privilege: You don't have the privilege required to use ElkUtils.
msg-no-self-pos: Couldn't read your position. Try again in a moment.
msg-no-elk: Couldn't find any elk you own in a loaded chunk within the search radius.
msg-target-not-loaded: Target player {0} has no entity loaded right now.
msg-recall-ok: ElkUtils: your elk has been teleported to you.
msg-goto-ok: ElkUtils: teleported you to your elk.
msg-send-ok: ElkUtils: your elk has been sent to {0}.
msg-fetch-ok: ElkUtils: {0} has been teleported to your elk.
msg-fetched-by: ElkUtils: you were teleported to {0}'s elk.
msg-move-ok: ElkUtils: your elk has been teleported to {0}.
